title: Saturation numbers for $3$-uniform Berge-$K_4$
summary: The saturation number $\text{sat}_r(n,\mathcal{F})$ is the minimum number of hyperedges in an $r$-uniform $\mathcal{F}$-saturated hypergraph on $n$ vertices. We determine this parameter for $3$-uniform Berge-$K_4$ hypergraphs, proving that $\text{sat}_3(n,\text{Berge-}K_4)=n$ for $n =5,7,8$ and $n\ge 96$, while $\text{sat}_3(6,\text{Berge-}K_4)=5$.
